summary: Independent falsification found no blocking or important issues in the 36-run PXD070086 SDRF.

reviewer_context.context: Fresh delegated reviewer context; producer transcript and verdict not consulted.

spec_compliance.evidence: 37 columns and 36 uniform rows; template declarations ms-proteomics, human, cell-lines v1.1.0 match current template manifest; official parse_sdrf validator and repository structure check pass.

ontology_integrity.evidence: All six structured controlled terms checked by offline repository checker: no hallucinations, label mismatches, wrong ontology, or UNIMOD swaps. Official validator passes. Cellosaurus CVCL_U427 directly identifies Flp-In-T-REx-293 of human origin; HEK293 is an appropriate parent label.

source_evidence.evidence: Accession-scoped PRIDE project PXD070086 names parental Flp-In T-REx HEK293 and six treatment conditions. Depositor design labels each run. Publication PMC13550524 Methods supports 10 µM TH5487, 4H8 capture, antibody-free bead control, and parallel triplicate preparations. Cellosaurus CVCL_U427 supports exact derivative and female origin. HyStarMetadata.xml records timsTOF Pro 2; mqpar.xml confirms Trypsin/P search, modifications and 10 ppm precursor / 40 ppm TOF fragment settings.

file_mapping.evidence: Accession identity checked in all four files.json entries. SDRF 36 unique .d names exactly match 36 depositor design names, 36 ZIP-derived selected names, and all 36 mqpar.xml file paths; no extra or missing runs.

design_consistency.evidence: 36 runs form 3 peroxide states x 2 TH5487 states x 2 capture states, with exactly three biological replicate preparations per each of 12 groups and technical replicate 1 throughout. Each SDRF source/file assignment matches the depositor design; factor combinations and replicate indices recomputed.

omission_safety.evidence: Unsupported donor age, tissue, disease, and cell type remain not available. IgPIP depositor code is represented as antibody-free bead control per paper, not inferred to IgG. No pig/bovine organism was imported from erroneous PRIDE processing prose; human cell line is supported independently. Missing optional ancestry and developmental stage do not assert unverified values.
